item.title: Suez Canal closed after container ship runs aground
item.description: Traffic through the Suez Canal was halted on Thursday after a large container ship ran aground in the southern section. The canal authority chairman said: “Traffic will resume within 48 hours once the vessel is refloated.” Dozens of ships are waiting at both ends of the canal, and shipping analysts expect delays to ripple into European ports next week.

item.title: Rotterdam dockworkers strike halts port operations
item.description: Dockworkers at Rotterdam, Europe's largest port, walked out on Thursday over pay. The union said the strike would last 24 hours. Container terminals in Rotterdam stood idle and shipping lines diverted vessels.

item.title: Football final ends in dramatic draw
item.description: The football final ended level after extra time and will be replayed next week.

item.title: Election results announced in the capital
item.description: Officials announced the final election count on Thursday evening.
